entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yo, Akechi.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: What is it?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You got any idea who the[n]true culprit might be?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oh yeah! You said you saw[n]a masked guy, right?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I wanted to ask about that too.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Did you really see him?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That masked guy's gotta be[n]the true culprit, right?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If this so-called true culprit[n]is acting alone, then there[n]can be no mistake about it.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I see.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The next question is, who[n]is that masked man?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Unfortunately, I do not[n]know that much.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ugh, you're useless.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That is quite harsh.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Aw, you're making me blush!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That wasn't a compliment...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: At this point, I have yet[n]to even grasp any clues.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But once this is dealt with,[n]I will surely capture him.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I promise you that.
We'll be counting on you.
Can you do it?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Perfect. Leave it to me.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hm? Do you not trust me?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It may sound somewhat odd for[n]me to say this, but I am an[n]exceptional detective.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I assure you, I will catch this[n]culprit. Look forward to it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He doesn't have any clues, but he's[n]confident enough to say he can[n]definitely catch the guy...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No wonder he's a star detective. Even[n]the way he talks about these things is[n]different from us.
